summary: Russia-Ukraine standoff deepens after inconclusive US-Russia talks; SGX indicates ~200-pt gap down from Friday's 17,450 to ~17,100. Speaker plans 17,000 put buys financed by selling 17,500 calls; 17,400 shows huge call OI = resistance; violent range 17,000-17,800.

events.claim: Dow fell over 500 points and Nasdaq fell 3% on Friday Feb 11, 2022 as Russia-Ukraine standoff escalated
US and Russian presidents spoke on Saturday Feb 12 with no concrete positive outcome
17,400 call strike saw the largest open-interest addition on Feb 11
RBI policy earlier that week was well received by markets

lessons: Financed protection: buy puts by selling overpriced upside premium instead of paying for hedges.
Huge call OI at a strike marks near-term resistance when price stalls below it.
quote: I will be buying put options and I will be financing it by selling some call options.

summary: Nifty crashed 532 points - worst day since Apr-2021 Delta selloff - as the Rs 22,000-crore ABG Shipyard fraud hit ICICI Bank and SBI plus global risk-off; closed at the 200-DMA near 16,800; about Rs 9 lakh crore of market cap wiped out; expects 100-200 point recovery.

events.claim: ABG Shipyard fraud of about Rs 22,000 crore reported; ICICI Bank and SBI named with highest exposure
Nifty fell 532 points on Feb 14, 2022, worse than the 524-point fall on April 12, 2021 (Delta variant day)
Nifty closed at its 200-day moving average near 16,800; roughly Rs 9 lakh crore of market value wiped out
HDFC Ltd stock fell from above 3,000 to about 2,300, a drop of more than 20%

lessons: A 500-point crash day that closes on the 200-DMA often produces 100-200 points of recovery the next session.
Never trade unhedged when India VIX spikes more than 20% in a day.
quote: Better to be safe than sorry.
leaks: technical-analysis course launch promo with pricing

summary: Headline-driven whipsaw in US (Dow swung 400 points three times) as Russia talks open and shut; India fell 3% (worst in a year) on the ABG scam; closed 16,800 at the 200-DMA. Expects 16,800-17,100 consolidation with risk of testing 16,600 later.

events.claim: Dow swung roughly 400 points three times overnight on alternating Russia-Ukraine headlines
India January CPI inflation about 6%; RBI projected around 5.7% going forward
Crude near $96, gold rising and rupee weakening indicating war fear
India fell more than 3% while Russia's own market fell only 1.5-2%, blamed on the ABG Shipyard scam

lessons: Threats move markets more than wars: stay light until uncertainty resolves.
Defensives falling with the market (ITC -6%) signals broad capitulation, not rotation.
quote: Keep watching for global news flow; some positive news and the market shoots up, some negative and it crashes.
dup_flag: Recaps Feb-14 crash and Delta-variant analogy from 0849

summary: Russia says troops returning to bases (11:15am news) and markets V-shape: Nifty +500 from lows, Bank Nifty +1,650; the prior day's Rs 9 lakh crore loss fully recovered. DIIs bought Rs 4,422 cr vs FII sales Rs 2,300 cr; FY22 FII selling crosses Rs 2 lakh crore.

events.claim: Russia announced on Feb 15, 2022 that some troops were returning to their bases after exercises near Ukraine
FIIs sold about Rs 2,300 crore while DIIs bought Rs 4,422 crore on Feb 15
FII cash-market selling in FY22 crossed Rs 2 lakh crore by mid-February
Fed expected to hike 50bp in mid-March; LIC IPO expected by end-March

lessons: Markets can round-trip an entire crash in a day when war fear eases - size for whipsaw, not direction.
A rising market slows but does not stop determined institutional selling.
quote: Yesterday 9 lakh crore was lost and today the entire 9 lakh crore has been added.

summary: Aftershock framing: consolidation expected, not resolution. LIC IPO (Rs 63,000 cr, India's largest) with about half reserved for retail/policyholders/employees seen as a market support until listing; FII futures 53% long = healthy; December 18,000 straddle still comfortable (breakevens 15,500/20,500).

events.claim: LIC IPO sized at Rs 63,000 crore, the largest in Indian history, with about 50% reserved for retail, policyholders and employees
FII index-futures positioning was 53% long / 47% short
Margins on stock options were set to increase from Friday that week
December-series 18,000 short straddle written at about Rs 2,500 premium (breakevens 15,500 and 20,500)

lessons: Mega-IPO liquidity needs keep an entire market supported - respect the calendar.
FII long% between 45-55 marks a healthy market; below 45 is danger, above 70 is overbought.
quote: This whole year the market is going to be a traders market - 16,500 to 18,500, again and again.

summary: Fell 200, rallied 250 after 1:30pm, then a 2:30pm NATO troop-buildup claim erased it within an hour (Bank Nifty -450, Nifty -200). LIC IPO dates announced (Mar 10-14) clashing with five-state election results day. FIIs -1,890 cr, DIIs +1,180 cr.

events.claim: NATO said on Feb 16, 2022 that Russia was adding troops rather than withdrawing
LIC IPO window set for March 10-14, 2022, opening the same day as five state election results
Bank Nifty made four 600-700 point swings in a day, about 2,500-3,000 points total

lessons: In event weeks a 600-point index swing can reverse within one hour - near-expiry option selling becomes Russian roulette.
A headline that barely moves the origin country's market but crashes yours signals local positioning, not fundamentals.
quote: The standoff between bulls and bears is actually worse than the standoff between Russia and Ukraine.

summary: Certain vs uncertain uncertainties: dated events (budget, election results) are tradable risk; Russia-Ukraine is not. Worst US night of 2022 (Dow -600, Nasdaq -3%) then recovery on talks; green-hydrogen policy hopes lift RIL; HDFC holding green in a crash flags bottoming.

events.claim: Dow fell more than 600 points and Nasdaq 3% overnight - the worst US session of 2022 to that date
Russia agreed to diplomatic talks; Russian foreign minister to meet US counterpart
India announced a green hydrogen policy after market hours on Feb 17, 2022
Brent crude shot up beyond $95 during the session before cooling

lessons: Trade known-date events; stand aside from open-ended uncertainty.
A stock holding firm while its market crashes shows accumulation strength.
quote: When the actual bad news comes and the market moves higher, it means the bad news was already factored in.

summary: Weekly-expiry chaos: broke 17,220 then +200, repeated 100-point reversals; last half hour Bank Nifty fell 170 points in 5 minutes; VIX +6-7% on no news; Nifty green all day until the final minutes. Series netted only ~150 points in 15 sessions.

events.claim: India VIX rose 6-7% on a day with no negative global news
Nifty moved only about 150 points close-to-close across 15 sessions while swinging 500-600 points daily
FIIs sold every session since Jan 12, 2022 except one day of roughly Rs 100 crore buying

lessons: When daily range dwarfs the series' net move, direction is noise - only extremes pay.
Late-day acceleration is institutional selling; never carry unhedged shorts into the last half hour.
quote: Bank Nifty went 500 down, 500 up, 500 down - a crazy, crazy market.

summary: Calm global cues point to an inside candle. History lesson: Jan-2011's three straight days of ~Rs 1,000-cr FII selling preceded a 20% annual fall, while Apr-2021's Rs 21-25k cr selling saw the market rise - retail is now the absorber; LIC IPO's retail-heavy allocation extends that logic.

events.claim: In January 2011, FIIs sold about Rs 1,000 crore on three consecutive sessions and the market fell about 20% that year
In April 2021, FIIs sold Rs 21,000-25,000 crore yet Nifty rose from 16,000 to 17,500
LIC IPO reserved roughly 50% for retail, policyholders and employees

lessons: FII selling matters only relative to who absorbs it - track the buyer, not the seller.
After a wild Tuesday/Wednesday, Thursday expiries often resolve into quieter inside candles.
quote: Thank god retail people are coming in a big way to support the market.

summary: Inside-candle consolidation amid Russia zigzag (new exercises, Putin overseeing). VIX +0.73% but above 20; sold 17,700/17,800 calls with an 18,000 hedge; March premiums ultra-high (16,000 PE ~Rs 125). FIIs -2,529 cr, DIIs +1,929 cr.

events.claim: Russia announced new military exercises including ballistic-missile tests personally overseen by Putin
March-series 16,000 put traded around Rs 125 with India VIX above 20
FII cash selling had persisted for 11 straight months

lessons: High VIX is the option seller's wage - sell far strikes with defined-risk wings, never naked.
An inside candle after panic means consolidation: wait for the range break instead of predicting direction.
quote: FIIs and DIIs are two big rowdy gangs, and retail people are always the ones killed in the crossfire.
leaks: live session with Delta Exchange CEO announcement

summary: Weekend Biden-Putin summit-in-principle news fades; SGX only -100/-110 because LIC IPO and local overhangs dominate. LIC grey market at ~Rs 50 discount; Nasdaq death cross Friday. Only technical that matters now is the 200-DMA at 16,850.

events.claim: Biden and Putin agreed in principle to meet, conditional on no invasion of Ukraine
Macron-Putin call lasted about 105 minutes and produced agreement on ceasefire talks for eastern Ukraine
Nasdaq printed a death cross (50-DMA crossing below 200-DMA) on Friday Feb 18, 2022
LIC shares indicated a grey-market discount of about Rs 50

lessons: When OI and technicals go meaningless, the 200-DMA is the only line that matters.
A grey-market discount on a mega IPO is a live referendum on market appetite.
quote: No open interest, no technicals - the only technical we see is the 200-day moving average.

summary: Russia declines to confirm the Biden meeting and risk-off returns; Nifty broke 17,100 then DII-aided +250 rebound; Bank Nifty swung +900/-500; India VIX up a third straight day (~23). Warns 17,000 and the 200-DMA (16,816) could break before expiry.

events.claim: Russia said on Feb 21-22, 2022 it was not ready to confirm the proposed Biden-Putin meeting
Germany's market underperformed on energy-price inflation as Russian gas supply wavered
Mid-March event stack cited: LIC IPO, five state elections, Fed meeting

lessons: Good news that lasts under 24 hours is a squeeze, not a trend - fade the euphoria.
When exchange flow data publishes late, expect the number (FII selling) to be ugly.
quote: One day good news, market shoots up; the next day bad news, market shoots down.

summary: Russia recognizes Donetsk and Luhansk and sends peacekeepers; Russian index -13/-15% and -17% after hours; Russian VIX ~92.5 vs 85-90 at Lehman/COVID peaks. FIIs' Oct-Feb cash selling Rs 1.65 lakh crore called unprecedented; breadth 1:7.

events.claim: Russia recognized the Donetsk and Luhansk rebel regions and deployed troops described as peacekeepers
Russian MOEX fell about 13-15% and its VIX spiked to about 92.5
FIIs sold about Rs 1,65,000 crore in Indian cash markets from October 2021 to February 2022
Advance/decline ratio was 1:7 on Feb 21 with only 10-12 Nifty-50 stocks positive

lessons: A two-year crisis cadence (2011, 2013, 2015, 2018, 2020) means the next shock is always in range - keep dry powder.
Breadth (1:7) warns before the index does.
quote: For a long-term investor, this crisis is a very good opportunity to invest.

summary: Opened -350 (vs SGX -200) with the first decisive 200-DMA break in ~2 years, then a +350 recovery; Russia recovered from -8/9% as its VIX fell 96 to 82; India VIX up a 4th straight day, intraday ~28. Recovery on bad news = bottom signal; 16,800 double bottom.

events.claim: Nifty fell about 350 points at the open on Feb 22, 2022 and briefly broke its 200-day moving average
Russian market fell 8-9% at open then recovered most losses; Russian VIX fell from about 96 to 82
FIIs sold Rs 3,246 cr (about Rs 8,000 cr over 3 sessions; February MTD about Rs 27,000 cr); DIIs bought over Rs 4,100 cr
India VIX hit an intraday high near 27.8-28, rising a fourth straight session

lessons: A market that rallies on bad news has found its bottom - that low becomes the reference.
Exit all short-premium positions if VIX crosses 30; election weeks are the only exception.
quote: If the market recovers even when the news is bad, the bottom must be in place.

summary: Global rebound: Russia closed green (VIX above 80 = violent two-way), Biden speech offered nothing severe; S&P 500 entered correction (>10%); India still above its 200-DMA unlike the US. 17,000 call OI implies put-seller breakeven 17,200 - a short-covering target; range 17,000-17,300.

events.claim: S&P 500 entered correction territory, defined in the US as a fall of more than 10% from the high
Hong Kong was grappling with an Omicron wave plus China's tech and property crackdowns
Nifty futures traded more than 30 points at a discount to spot
Massive call writing at 17,000 during the prior panic left sellers' breakeven near 17,200

lessons: Separate the spot view from the futures basis - discount unwinding alone can deliver 30-40 points.
US regime definitions: over 10% is correction, over 20% is bear market - use them as switches.
quote: The market may not go up so much even on a gap-up, because the futures discount has to unwind first.

summary: Calm day until 3:00-3:15pm FII basket sale (-100 Nifty / -200 Bank Nifty in 15 minutes). February FII sales cross Rs 39,000 cr (Rs 3,417 cr today, highest of the month); Kotak +100 pts vs ICICI drag; VIX -8% but judged too little. Expiry range from OI math: 16,920-17,280.

events.claim: FIIs sold Rs 3,417 crore on Feb 23, 2022 - the highest single-day February selling - with about Rs 39,000 crore sold in the month
Ukraine declared a 30-day state of emergency on Feb 23, 2022
Russia's parliament approved the deployment of troops to eastern Ukraine
Nifty closed at 17,100 on both the January expiry (Jan 27) and this session - 19 sessions, no net move

lessons: Options-implied expiry range equals max-OI strike plus/minus collected premium - your no-go zone.
Institutional basket orders hit the 3:00-3:15 window; never assume the last half hour is calm.
quote: Retail and domestic institutions open the market; FIIs close the market.

summary: Dow whipsawed +250 to -500 on Ukraine emergency, troop approval and cyberattacks; Nasdaq near bear-market territory (-19-20%); SGX -300 on expiry day and printed a 15,500 low. 200-DMA decisive-break risk flagged; March regime seen shifting to 16,400-17,400.

events.claim: Ukraine suffered cyberattacks on banks and government websites on Feb 23, 2022
Nasdaq was down about 19-20% from highs (near bear-market definition) while the Dow entered correction territory
SGX Nifty printed a 15,500 low in pre-open panic with no circuit limits
FIIs hold roughly one-third of the market cap of large-cap Indian companies

lessons: Circuit-free proxies can print absurd lows in panic - never place market orders into them.
If the 200-DMA breaks decisively, the next support is 3-4% lower - plan the ladder before the break.
quote: If the 200-day moving average breaks decisively, the next support is only 16,400.

summary: War day: Nifty fell about 900 points (roughly 1,000 from the prior close), Bank Nifty about 2,000; 200-DMA and the 16,400 swing low both broke. India VIX closed decisively above 30 (US ~37, Russia ~127). Advice: flat until clarity; long-term staged entries begin.

events.claim: Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine on Feb 24, 2022
India VIX closed decisively above 30; US VIX traded near 37 and Russian VIX near 127
Nifty fell about 900-1,000 points and Bank Nifty about 2,000 points in the session
The rupee depreciated more than one rupee against the dollar as capital exited

lessons: VIX above 30 means flat: no positions, no exceptions except election weeks.
Near a bottom, stage entries in 20-25% tranches instead of calling the exact low.
quote: We are not at the bottom, but we are somewhere near the bottom - probably 15,500 to 16,000.

summary: VIX-30 rule forced him flat at the open (validated by a further 300-400 point fall); Biden sanctions excluded crude and gas, so Nasdaq rallied 7% low-to-high and the Dow 1,000 points; US VIX fell 37 to 30. FIIs -6,000 cr (5-day >15,000 cr). Premiums absurd (Mar-3 15,350 PE ~Rs 150).

events.claim: US sanctions on Russia announced Feb 24 excluded crude oil and natural gas
Nasdaq rallied about 7% from intraday low to high and the Dow about 1,000 points after the sanctions detail
Crude briefly hit $105 and gold about $1,975 around the sanctions announcement
FIIs sold Rs 6,000 crore on Feb 24 and more than Rs 15,000 crore across five sessions

lessons: The VIX-above-30 exit rule costs a little and saves fortunes - obey it mechanically.
Sanctions that spare commodities flip war panic into the sharpest squeezes; policy detail moves markets more than the war itself.
quote: In a war nobody is a winner - somebody just loses more and somebody less.

summary: Uncomfortable rally: opened ~16,500 and reached 16,750 with mid/small caps leading despite weak US futures; FIIs -4,400 cr (February >41,000 cr, a one-year high), DIIs +4,300 cr. Roadmap: crises break the 200-DMA, then the reclaim triggers the sustained rally (COVID analog 10,800 to 18,600).

events.claim: FIIs' February 2022 cash-market selling crossed Rs 41,000 crore - the highest in a year
Nifty recovered from about 16,500 to 16,750 while US futures stayed negative
The correction from the October 2021 high measured 18,600 to 16,200, about 2,400 points
More than 20,000 Indian nationals were in Ukraine with evacuation flights disrupted

lessons: After every major crisis the market reclaims its 200-DMA and then extends - use the reclaim as the long-entry trigger.
Rallies led by mid/small caps while futures stay weak are squeezes, not trends - expect retests.
quote: When the market corrects significantly it falls below the 200-DMA; when it takes out the 200-DMA again there will be a significant rally.

summary: SWIFT cutoffs send the ruble down ~50% (80 to 120 per dollar); Russia puts nuclear-capable forces on alert; Dow futures swung from +850 Friday to -600. SGX -350 then stabilizing. The trade is to stay away; only the 200-DMA matters.

events.claim: US and European allies cut major Russian banks from the SWIFT network over Feb 26-27, 2022
The ruble opened about 50% lower against the dollar, from about 80 to 120
Russia placed its nuclear-capable forces on combat readiness on Feb 27, 2022
FIIs sold about Rs 14,000 crore across three sessions and more than Rs 2 lakh crore in FY22

lessons: Markets digest good and bad news but not uncertainty - stand aside until the path clears.
War markets fall in staircases and rally in avalanches - shorts die in the bounces.
quote: Markets can take positive things, markets can take negative things, but markets cannot take uncertainty.

summary: Wild round trip: low 16,366 (-600), +450 recovery, close +135 (half from Reliance alone). Russia blocked non-resident share sales after BP's $25bn Rosneft exit; central bank doubled rates to 20%; India VIX rose 7% on an up day. FIIs -3,948 cr, DIIs +4,100 cr.

events.claim: Nifty hit an intraday low of 16,366 on Feb 28, 2022, recovered about 450 points and closed 135 higher
BP announced exit from its roughly 20% Rosneft stake (about $25 billion) and Russia then barred non-residents from selling Russian shares
Russia's central bank roughly doubled interest rates from about 9% to 20%
India VIX rose about 7% on a day the Nifty closed higher

lessons: Closing the market to foreign sellers halts price discovery, not the outflow - Russia chose the former.
A VIX that rises on an up-day warns the market is pricing headline risk, not direction.
quote: Non-residents are not allowed to sell any more shares in Russia - maybe we should announce the same thing!

summary: Two-day news gap after the holiday: 65-km Russian column toward Kyiv, TV infrastructure bombed; crude at $110. ADR damage (HDFC Bank -10%, ICICI -6% in two US sessions) to hit Bank Nifty. FII selling called worse than Lehman once adjusted; LIC IPO possibly postponed, freeing DIIs to defend.

events.claim: A 65-kilometre Russian military column advanced toward Kyiv in early March 2022 with TV infrastructure hit
HDFC Bank ADR fell about 10% and ICICI Bank ADR about 6% across two US sessions
Reports suggested the LIC IPO might be postponed
Crude oil traded around $110 per barrel

lessons: ADR moves import overnight verdicts on your heavyweights - check New York before betting on Mumbai.
Flow crises, not price crises, define regime change: FII outflows adjusted for market size exceeded even Lehman's.
quote: This is the worst year in the history of the Indian stock market - in terms of FII selling.

summary: Familiar pattern with a late twist: sell-off below SGX, then 3:00-3:20pm Bank Nifty +700 on Ukraine-talks hope; Powell keeps March hikes on track; crude above $110-112; HDFC broke 2,300; Bank Nifty premiums about 10x normal. Expiry range seen 16,500-16,800.

events.claim: Bank Nifty rallied about 700 points between 3:00 and 3:20pm on reports Ukraine was ready for a second round of talks
Powell said the Fed still intends to raise rates in March despite the war
Crude traded above $110, touching about $112
Bank Nifty fell about 1,200 points intraday before the late rally

lessons: Recovery without news means sellers are exhausted - news-driven rallies are only short covering.
When options 1,000 points away carry 5-10x normal premium, the market is paying you to stay small.
quote: If the market goes higher without any positive news, all the negatives have been factored in.

summary: US broad-based rally (29 of 30 Dow stocks up); Powell's 25bp preference versus feared 50bp is relief; crude $117 (+20% in three days) is the key India risk; Belarus peace talks; ADRs +2%; a ceasefire headline could close Nifty near 17,000.

events.claim: Powell signaled a preference for a 25 basis point March hike rather than 50
Crude reached about $117 per barrel, up roughly 20% in three sessions
Russia-Ukraine peace talks were held on the Belarus border
FIIs sold about Rs 45,000 crore in February 2022

lessons: Less-hawkish-than-feared central bank messaging is the most reliable short-covering catalyst in risk-off regimes.
Oversold markets turn small good news into violent rallies - position for the reaction, not the news.
quote: When markets are oversold, even a small positive news can trigger a huge short covering.
